nodes.label: PostgreSQL pgvector HNSW Index
nodes.description: Approximate nearest neighbor index using Hierarchical Navigable Small World graphs for cosine similarity search over 768-dimensional embeddings in PostgreSQL.

nodes.label: Recursive CTE Bounded Graph Traversal
nodes.description: PostgreSQL recursive common table expression pattern for depth-limited graph traversal with cycle detection and path accumulation.

nodes.label: Evidence-First Provenance Architecture
nodes.description: First-class evidence table design where all node/edge assertions require explicit evidence_id foreign keys, separating candidate claims from verified facts.

nodes.label: JSON Schema v2.1.0 Interchange Format
nodes.description: JSON Schema draft-07 definition for sovereign knowledge graph interchange, validating node types, edge types, evidence requirements, and ID patterns.

nodes.label: Stable Semantic ID Generation Protocol
nodes.description: Deterministic ID generation using normalized text hashing (n_ prefix for nodes, ev_ for evidence) ensuring reproducible IDs across deployments.

nodes.label: Candidate→Validate→Commit Pipeline
nodes.description: Three-stage graph mutation pipeline: candidate scoring with weighted multi-signal ranking, validation with referential/cycle/evidence checks, then atomic commit with audit logging.

nodes.label: Append-Only Audit Log Architecture
nodes.description: Immutable audit_log table recording all INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE operations with old_values/new_values JSONB, verified flag, and SHA-256 chain hash for tamper evidence.

nodes.label: Hybrid Vector + Lexical Ranking
nodes.description: Multi-signal retrieval combining pgvector cosine similarity with PostgreSQL FTS (tsvector/tsquery) scores, weighted fusion for final candidate ranking.

evidence.title: pgvector HNSW Index Documentation
evidence.snippet: HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World) index for approximate nearest neighbor search with cosine distance, supporting up to 2000 dimensions.

evidence.title: PostgreSQL Recursive CTE Documentation
evidence.snippet: Recursive queries using WITH RECURSIVE for hierarchical and graph traversal with cycle detection.

evidence.title: Khawrizm Knowledge Policy v2
evidence.snippet: A record is not an asserted fact merely because it appears in an LLM prompt, generated JSON, design note, benchmark description, or repository comment. Assertions require evidence.

evidence.title: JSON Schema Draft-07 Release Notes
evidence.snippet: Draft-07 adds if/then/else, $comment, $defs, readOnly/writeOnly, and other validation keywords.

evidence.title: Inference Pipeline Implementation
evidence.snippet: Deterministic scoring with weighted multi-signal ranking (semantic, lexical, structural, type_compatibility, evidence) and validation with self_reference, evidence_required, cycle_detected guards.

evidence.title: Graph Audit Script
evidence.snippet: Validates graph integrity: node/edge/evidence counts, SHA-256 hashes on evidence, referential integrity, cycle detection, orphan node reporting.

evidence.title: PostgreSQL Schema Initialization
evidence.snippet: nodes, edges, evidence, audit_log tables with HNSW index, FK constraints, CHECK constraints on status/operation enums, append-only audit design.

evidence.title: Hybrid Search SQL Functions
evidence.snippet: PostgreSQL FTS with tsvector/tsquery, hybrid ranking function combining cosine similarity and lexical score, recursive CTE bounded_traversal with depth limit.

constraints.description: All edge.source and edge.target must reference existing node.id values
constraints.expression: FOREIGN KEY (source) REFERENCES nodes(id), FOREIGN KEY (target) REFERENCES nodes(id)

constraints.description: All node.provenance entries must reference existing evidence.id values
constraints.expression: FOREIGN KEY (evidence_id) REFERENCES evidence(id) for each provenance entry

constraints.description: Node IDs must match n_[a-z0-9_]{2,64} pattern
Evidence SHA-256 hash must be 64 lowercase hex characters
Edges cannot have source == target (no self-loops)
